seo.title: Lunar and Biodynamic Calendar August 2026
seo.description: Lunar biodynamic calendar for hair and skin care in August 2026 at Salón Pilar Palomares. Discover the best days for your haircut, color, and hair removal.

hero.desc: When beauty follows the rhythm of nature
hero.imgAlt: Cosmos biodynamic calendar: lunar rhythms for conscious beauty

agua.desc: Just as the moon governs the tides, it also influences the water that makes up 70% of our body. At Pilar Palomares, we use this ancestral knowledge to enhance the effectiveness of each biotherapy.
agua.imgAlt: The rhythm of water and lunar influence: water nymphs under the full moon, representing the cosmobiological connection

agosto.introText1: Nature reaches its maximum fullness in August, inviting us to live in harmony with its rhythms. It is a time to care with awareness: protecting and balancing against the summer sun and heat.
agosto.introText2: Biodynamics reminds us of the importance of sustaining this rhythm with respect, accompanying the skin and hair so that they maintain their balance, hydration, and capacity for adaptation.

corte.desc: Hair responds to lunar cycles. August offers very precise windows for cutting depending on the result you seek: stimulating growth, strengthening the fiber, enhancing curls, or sealing the ends.
corte.d1_2_27_29: Perfect moment to enhance the natural shape of curls, favoring movement with harmony and definition.
corte.d2_5_29_31: A cut will help stimulate faster growth, making it an ideal period to keep ends healthy and give hair a renewed look.
corte.d11_22: Cut to seal the ends, recommended period to care for length, promoting stronger ends and healthy, revitalized hair.
corte.d15_18: Cut to strengthen and slow hair loss, recommended period to reinforce hair fiber and maintain hair health.

color.desc: The moon influences how hair absorbs and retains color. Choosing the right day makes the difference between a shade that lasts and one that fades. August offers very specific windows to work on coloring with optimal results.
color.d12_15: Favorable days to apply color if you seek to achieve more intense and vibrant tones, highlighting the natural beauty of the hair.
color.d15_18: Ideal period to work on color, favoring greater fixation and helping to prolong its intensity and duration.
color.d18_20: An especially favorable moment to perform color work, enhancing luminosity and allowing hair to reflect all its natural beauty.

depil.desc: Recommended periods for hair removal that allow hair to grow more slowly, maintaining smooth and healthy skin. Take advantage of these moments to care for skin texture and hydration, enhancing well-being and prolonging the feeling of softness.
depil.d18_20: Especially favorable phase for body biodynamic hair removal, slowing hair regrowth and keeping skin smooth and hydrated.
depil.imgAlt: Skin care and biodynamic hair removal in August 2026

treat.desc: Skin and body benefit greatly from synchronizing care with cosmos cycles. Tune your cabin rituals to enhance active assimilation, hydration, and tissue firmness.
treat.d2_15: Ascending moon, ideal for Brightening, Detox, and Deep Hydration treatments taking advantage of maximum cellular receptivity.
treat.d18_20: Optimal phase to care for skin texture and hydration, enhancing well-being after summer sun exposure.
treat.d20_31: Descending moon, perfect for Anti-Aging, Sensitive, Straffung, and body firming or drainage protocols.
treat.imgAlt: Biodynamic facial and body treatments in August 2026
